Jordan / team,

We can make an exception in certain cases but need to follow audit and tax requirements. Policy summary: we require either (A) an unredacted resale certificate with EIN (preferred), or (B) a redacted resale certificate accompanied by one of the following transmitted over a secure channel to Finance only: a signed W-9 with EIN, or the state registration showing the EIN.

For an invoice hold release, Finance will accept a temporary manual override if the DocuSign envelope proves the signer and the state registration contains the EIN and matches the company name and address on the PO. We'll also document the verification in the vendor tax file for audit.

Two asks for Greenpine if they want expedited release:
- Provide the state registration as a sealed PDF (state office filing) or a certified extract (Greenpine_State_Reg_GreenpineLLC.pdf).
- Deliver a DocuSign-signed, flattened PDF (so we can ingest it) OR transmit the full EIN by secure SFTP/ShareFile to finance@redwood.com.

Note: Our automated intake pipeline currently rejects PDFs where the EIN field contains an annotation/redaction layer instead of a flattened image. I attached a brief intake error log showing the failure for the attached redacted PDF.

If the customer can provide the DocuSign link and the state reg file by EOD Monday, we can problem-solve the temporary override and aim to release the invoice hold.

Quick technical note on ingestion: our PDF parser flags redaction layers (annotations/OCG) as non-text that hide critical tokens. Typical remedies:

- Ask the customer to "flatten" the PDF in their PDF editor (File > Print to PDF or Save as Flattened) so redaction becomes a rasterized image. That usually allows OCR to pick up the visible digits and our intake to proceed.
- Alternatively, if they must mask the EIN for public security, they can supply a second secure file with the full EIN (SFTP/email to finance) and a signed affidavit confirming the masking was applied to the copy shared with vendors.
- If engineering has to ingest the redacted file, we can add a one-off parser rule to accept a redaction annotation as long as the DocuSign envelope ID matches and finance approves. That requires Finance manual sign-off and an audit note.

Priyom / infra: please confirm whether a one-off parser override is feasible this week and what the audit trail would look like.

Marissa Cole
Product Ops
Redwood Inference
